messages:
maria (AM): Quick heads-up — Renewal with Voltix is coming up. They're asking for a 2.5x uplift and want a 30% discount on dedicated capacity if we commit 12 months. POC still in flight. Need deal desk + legal check. @sam can you share pricing calc?

sam (AE): Copying numbers now. Voltix current commit = $250k/mo, wants to peak at ~$625k. Are they asking for an effective price floor or a % off list?

raj (solutions): POC profile: 2 models, heavy embeddings + reranking, sustained QPS. We can propose burst pools + prefix cache to reduce token spend. Can we offer quantization recs to hit their cost target?

olivia (CSM): Customer is also worried about SLAs and data residency. They asked for on-prem option in the contract. Legal will need answers to the security questionnaire before commit.

lee (legal): We'll need to scope Private deployment terms. Any elevated liability or custom indemnities? Price concessions need explicit dealdesk approval.

sam (AE): Quick calc in spreadsheet: baseline = $250k commit. 30% off dedicated list on uplift would be aggressive. Alternative: stepped discount if they hit higher commit tiers. Sharing link: https://redwood.atlassian/voltix/price-calc (private)

dealdesk-bot: New price exception request created: DR-2042. Approvers: @lee, @sophia (revops), @maria.

maria (AM): @dealdesk-bot thanks. @sophia can you review? We need a narrow special term — capped usage, 90-day POC credits, and an explicit auto-fallback to hosted if private cannot be delivered.

sophia (revops): I can take a look tomorrow AM. Need ARR math, churn risk, and margin impact. Also what security package are they asking for — ISO + SOC2 + KMS?

raj (solutions): They asked for ISO and SOC2 and customer-managed KMS. For the POC we can run hosted with an isolated project and exportable audit logs. Private adds ~6–8 weeks for setup.

olivia (CSM): Tight timeline from their side — they want contract signed in 4 weeks. Is 6–8 weeks for Private a deal blocker?

lee (legal): If Private setup exceeds timeline, propose interim: committed hosted with contractual SLAs on data handling + a migration clause to Private within X days. That reduces blocker risk.

sam (AE): Proposed commercial: 12‑month commit at $500k/mo with a 20% blended discount, 90‑day POC credits of $100k, and a migration clause. I'll draft a term sheet to reflect that.

maria (AM): Also include rollback pricing if usage drops below the committed threshold. @raj can you provide perf numbers to justify 500k/mo capacity?

raj (solutions): I'll attach perf summary and estimated cost savings from caching + batching. Early numbers show we meet their latency SLOs on Dedicated at 4x the current throughput.

maria (AM): :thumbsup: Great. @sophia flagging for dealdesk approval DR-2042. If approved we can proceed to signature with staged delivery (hosted -> private migration).

sophia (revops): I reviewed the numbers; prelim approve contingent on margin >= 28% and legal signoff on the migration clause. Scheduling a quick sync 10:30 PT tomorrow to finalize.

sam (AE): I'll host a 30-min sync with the customer tomorrow to walk the term sheet and migration plan. Thanks all.
thread_summary: Voltix renewal: customer requests large uplift + 30% discount; POC underway; legal asks re: private/on-prem timeline; deal desk exception DR-2042 opened; proposed commercial compromise is 12mo at $500k/mo with 20% blended discount, 90-day POC credits, migration clause; revops conditional approval pending margin and legal signoff.
